details: split_writes: orienting on op files
idea dynamic_split_reads: dynamic claiming of tile-row input sticks between NCRISC reader and BRISC writer

split_writes: NCRISC shadow-tracks cb_output_tiles tiles_received (never pops), writes tiles owned by ((r+cg)*S)%P<S, flushes, pushes token in new cb_write_done(8); writer issues the rest, waits token, pops. All NCRISC waits become polling loops that serve writes (deadlock-free).

Protocol: shared L1 words R (reader: seq,front,OPEN/ACK/CLOSED) in cb6 page and W (writer: seq,back,ENTER/CLAIM/DONE) in cb7 page; writer polls only while waiting for output, ENTERs a row, reader ACKs (then waits DONE) or CLOSEs (writer abandons); row 0 pre-ACKed (writer idle, taps blocking). Claims gated by outstanding-read window per RISC (NIU RD_RESP counter). Duplicates at the meeting chunk benign (both land before push).

round2 idea silu_sfpu_schedule: cheaper SFPU SiLU body at same precision

claim unit = block of the static block partition; per-core claim word = program semaphore (host-initialized 0) packing F (low 16) / B (high 16); owner NoC-atomic +1, stealer +1<<16 on the victim with max unclaimed (probe reads); valid iff F_old+B_old < nb. Compute row count via cb_ctrl (CB 8) + read_tile_value mailbox; writer row index via cb_split_requests (always on in dynamic mode); short blocks padded to full slots so ring stays aligned; steal compiled out (static baseline path) when nb_max==1

quartic pair body = 48 SFPU instr + INCRWC + 4 SFPSWAP stall cycles (~55 cyc/pair measured). Plan: raw-TTI bit-identical quartic: const-reg clamps (L11=766,L13=512, SWAP mod 9), Y_BIAS fp16 LOADI, NEGATE_VC frees L11; then SFPLOADMACRO BEG (load+MAD y) and FIN (load+MUL+RND->L16+STORE) -> 38 instr/42 cyc per pair
